caption: The drawing contains two objects that appear to be cloth neckwear, each featuring a central knot with two fabric ends hanging down. Both objects are rendered in brown tones with an overlaid diamond-shaped grid pattern in a lighter, possibly greenish or yellow color. The larger object, positioned near the top center, is displayed in a spread-out state, with the fabric ends tied in the middle and hanging down, and the band extending horizontally. The smaller object, located toward the lower left, is similarly styled but placed beneath the larger one and appears flatter and less spread out, with its fabric ends also hanging down from a central knot. Both objects are set against a plain, off-white or beige background, and there is a faint wash of brownish color behind the lower object. The artist’s name, "JAMES H. C. VAIL," is inscribed in small text near the bottom left corner of the image.
title: Cravat
